The brief now assesses **`2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`**, using CI rather than a local test execution. I do not run:

```text

```

Green exact-head CI selects CI-sufficient evidence; description recheck itself never runs tests.

I add the new source-backed claim task to the tracker and record it as `failed`. That failed assessment remains recorded even after repair.

### 4. Repair the description under the retained course

```text
The rejected path has a test.
->

```

This correction does not narrow the stored original intent to reject unsigned events. I retain the supplied clean source-review and scope assessment; changing the description does not independently settle any code or scope contribution.
